title: Guideline
description: One version of one central guideline (ADR-0009). Guidelines are the operator's layer over the AI reviewer: versioned, immutable, and split by visibility - safety and medical guidelines are internal (never returned to a runner's client), style and training guidelines are public. A guideline can only be more conservative than the corpus in knowledge/heuristics, never less; the deterministic safety layer still runs before and after any model call.

guidelineId.description: Stable identity across versions: the same guideline edited is the same id with a higher version, and the audit trail points at the id, not at the text.

version.description: Monotonic per guidelineId. A new row, never an edit: the table is append-only, so a review that read version 3 can be replayed after version 4 exists.

tier.description: How hard the guideline is. Conflict order (ADR-0009): safety/non-negotiable > constraint > a runner's preference; default only fills a gap the runner has not spoken about.

scope.description: What the guideline governs. Safety and medical are the scopes that must stay internal; the others may be shown to the runner.

visibility.description: Two-layer visibility from ADR-0009. internal = the operator and the model only; public = the runner may read it in their console. The contract refuses internal safety text becoming public through this field's allOf clause.

text.description: The guideline itself, in the operator's language. It is not a comment template: the narrator's copy still lives in packages/i18n.

rationale.description: Why the guideline exists, required so a future operator inherits the reason rather than the sentence.

effectiveFrom.description: The training day the version starts to apply. The reviewer resolves the effective version per day; a review opened before this date uses the earlier one.

createdBy.description: Operator identity recorded with the version. One operator role in P0; the field is what makes a later multi-admin change a data question rather than a schema one.

supersedesVersion.description: The version this one replaces, when the change is a replacement rather than an addition. Absent for a new guideline.
